title: Claim Service Standards by Coverage Level, Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claims are valued and paid on the same basis at every coverage level, while the service periods differ by level. All periods are calendar days.

## Valuation and payment methods

- **Valuation basis:** stored property is valued for a claim at its actual cash value, at every level.
- **Payment methods:** a claim payment is issued by direct deposit (ACH) or by mailed check, at every level.

## Service periods by level

| Coverage level | Decision target (days after the claim file is complete) | Payment issue (days after approval) | Reconsideration window (days after a decision) | Recovered-property repayment (days after recovery) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 15 | 10 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 15 | 10 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 15 | 10 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 15 | 10 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 10 | 7 | 45 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 10 | 7 | 45 | 30 |

## How the columns differ across the card

| Period | $2,000 / $3,000 / $5,000 / $7,500 Plans | $10,000 / $15,000 Plans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Decision target | 15 days | 10 days |
| Payment issue | 10 days | 7 days |
| Reconsideration window | 30 days | 45 days |
| Recovered-property repayment | 30 days | 30 days |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

For a claim under a $15,000 Plan approved on a given day, the payment issue period is 7 days from that approval; under a $5,000 Plan the period is 10 days.
